headline: Treasure Coast traffic report: I-95 ramp closures, road work planned Nov. 13–20
subhead: Martin Highway and Oslo Road I-95 ramps, Port St. Lucie neighborhood streets and regional highways face scheduled restrictions.
teaser: Overnight I-95 ramp closures at Martin Highway and Oslo Road, Port St. Lucie side-street closures and resurfacing are on FDOT's Nov. 13–20 schedule.
body:
Drivers across Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties should prepare for another week of overnight I-95 work, ramp closures and daytime lane restrictions, according to the Florida Department of Transportation's traffic report for Nov. 13–20.

The most significant disruptions begin Sunday night, Nov. 15. They include closures of both northbound I-95 ramps at SW Martin Highway in Martin County, four separately scheduled ramp closures at the new Oslo Road interchange in Indian River County, and extended neighborhood road closures along SW Port St. Lucie Boulevard.

FDOT says roadwork schedules can change because of weather or unforeseen conditions. For live interstate traffic information, drivers can check [FL511](https://www.fl511.com/); updated construction information is available through [FDOT District 4](https://www.d4fdot.com/).

## Biggest closures to know about

- **I-95 northbound at SW Martin Highway, Exit 110, Martin County:** The exit ramp and entrance ramp are each scheduled for overnight closures from **8 p.m. to 6 a.m. Sunday, Nov. 15, through Thursday, Nov. 19**, for repaving. FDOT says only one of the affected ramps will close at a time. Signed detours will use Becker Road and nearby connecting roads.
- **I-95 at Oslo Road, Exit 143, Indian River County:** All four interchange ramps have separately scheduled **overnight closures Sunday, Nov. 15, from 9 p.m. to 6 a.m.** Crews will stagger the closures so two ramps are not closed at the same time. Additional nights later in November and early December are designated as contingencies.
- **SW Port St. Lucie Boulevard side streets:** Extended closures are possible on **SW Jaslo, Koler, McCoy, McCullough and McHord avenues and SW Paar Drive** for drainage and utility installation. Work may start at **7 a.m. Monday, Nov. 16**, with affected roads reopening by **5 p.m. Friday, Nov. 20**. Adjacent streets will not close simultaneously, and access to homes and businesses will be maintained.
- **SW Port St. Lucie Boulevard between SW Fisherman and SW Liberty avenues:** Full road closures may occur intermittently from **9 p.m. to 5 a.m. Monday, Nov. 16, through Friday, Nov. 20**, for utility work. Detours will use SW Fisherman Avenue, SW Liberty Avenue and SW Pisano Street.
- **I-95 mainline in Martin and St. Lucie counties:** Overnight work will reduce portions of I-95 by as many as two lanes in each direction, including the Bridge Road-to-county-line stretch in Martin County and the Gatlin Boulevard-to-Becker Road stretch in St. Lucie County.
- **Advance notice — I-95 at Kanner Highway, Exit 101:** The southbound entrance and exit ramps are scheduled for separate overnight closures **Nov. 30–Dec. 3**, outside this week's reporting window. Contingency dates are Dec. 6–10.

## Martin County

### I-95 ramp closures and overnight resurfacing

**I-95 between C.R. 708/SE Bridge Road and the Martin–St. Lucie county line:** Two southbound lanes are scheduled to close from **7:30 p.m. to 5:30 a.m.**, and two northbound lanes from **8:30 p.m. to 6:30 a.m.**, Sunday, Nov. 15, through Tuesday, Nov. 24. The work includes milling, resurfacing and signage improvements.

Two overnight ramp closures are also scheduled at **S.R. 714/SW Martin Highway, Exit 110**, Sunday, Nov. 15, through Thursday, Nov. 19:

- **Northbound exit ramp to Martin Highway:** Closed from 8 p.m. to 6 a.m. Drivers will continue north to **SW Becker Road, Exit 114**, travel west on Becker Road and take the southbound I-95 entrance ramp to reach the Martin Highway exit.
- **Northbound entrance ramp from Martin Highway:** Closed from 8 p.m. to 6 a.m. Drivers will use **eastbound Martin Highway, northbound SW Newfield Parkway and westbound SW Becker Road** to enter northbound I-95 at Becker Road.

FDOT says the ramp closures will occur one at a time, with signs directing motorists through the detours.

**Advance notice for Kanner Highway:** The **southbound I-95 entrance ramp from S.R. 76/SW Kanner Highway** and the **southbound I-95 exit to Kanner Highway, Exit 101**, are each scheduled for overnight closures from 8 p.m. to 6 a.m. Nov. 30 through Dec. 3. The entrance detour uses Kanner Highway, Pratt Whitney Road and Bridge Road; the exit detour sends drivers south to **Bridge Road, Exit 96**, and back north toward Kanner Highway. Weather contingency dates are Dec. 6–10.

### U.S. 1, A1A and Martin Highway

- **U.S. 1 in Hobe Sound, between SE Dixie Highway and SE Osprey Street:** One northbound lane may close from **7:30 a.m. to 5 p.m.** and again from **9 p.m. to 7 a.m.** Monday, Nov. 16, through Friday, Nov. 20. One southbound lane may close from **10 a.m. to 5 p.m.** Monday through Friday, with additional overnight southbound restrictions from **8 p.m. to 6 a.m.** Sunday, Nov. 15, through Thursday, Nov. 19. Access to homes and businesses will be maintained as resurfacing and trail construction continue.
- **S.R. A1A/NE Ocean Boulevard, from NE Shore Village Terrace toward the Jensen Beach Causeway:** One lane may close intermittently in either direction Monday, Nov. 16, through Friday, Nov. 20, for drainage and pavement-widening work. Flaggers will maintain two-way traffic.
- **S.R. 714/SW Martin Highway, between SW Stuart West Boulevard and Citrus Boulevard:** One lane may close intermittently from **7 p.m. to 6 a.m.** Sunday, Nov. 15, through Thursday, Nov. 19, for milling, resurfacing, roadway widening and light-pole installation. Flaggers will maintain traffic.

### Local maintenance and utility work

- **Palm City — S.R. 718/SW Martin Highway between SW Martin Downs Boulevard and SW 42nd Avenue:** One westbound lane may close from **9 a.m. to 4 p.m.** Monday, Nov. 16, through Friday, Nov. 20.
- **Stuart — SE Monterey Road between U.S. 1 and SE Dixie Highway:** Intermittent eastbound and westbound lane closures are planned from **9 a.m. to 4 p.m.** Monday through Friday.
- **Stuart — U.S. 1 between SE Indian Street and SE Monterey Road; NW 16th Street and NW 16th Place; and SE Monterey Road and Grumman Boulevard:** Intermittent lane closures are scheduled from **9 a.m. to 4 p.m.** Monday through Friday for utility work.
- **Stuart — SW Kanner Highway between SW Gaines Avenue and SW Salerno Road:** One northbound lane may close from **9 a.m. to 4 p.m.** Monday through Friday.
- **Stuart — NE Ocean Boulevard between Joe's Point Road and Tiger Shores Beach:** One southbound lane may close from **9 a.m. to 4 p.m.** Monday through Friday.
- **Port Mayaca — SW Conners Highway near the Port Mayaca Polo Club and Florida Trail recreation-area trailhead:** One lane in either direction may close from **9 a.m. to 4 p.m.** Monday through Friday.
- **Tequesta — U.S. 1 between SE Jupiter Inlet Way and Intracoastal Place:** One lane may close in either direction from **9 a.m. to 4 p.m. Friday, Nov. 20**, for paving work.

## St. Lucie County

### I-95 work near Becker Road, Gatlin Boulevard and Fort Pierce

- **I-95 between SW Gatlin Boulevard and just south of SW Becker Road:** Two northbound lanes may close from **8 p.m. to 6 a.m.**, and two southbound lanes from **7:30 p.m. to 5:30 a.m.**, Sunday, Nov. 15, through Friday, Nov. 20. Lane shifts are possible during resurfacing and pavement-marking work.
- **I-95 between Glades Cut-Off Road and just south of S.R. 70/Okeechobee Road:** Shoulder closures in both directions are scheduled from **6:30 a.m. to 7 p.m.**, and up to two lanes may close overnight from **8 p.m. to 6:30 a.m.**, Sunday, Nov. 15, through Friday, Nov. 20, for grading, signage, drill shafts and pavement markings.

### Port St. Lucie Boulevard and U.S. 1

- **S.R. 716/SE Port St. Lucie Boulevard between SE Seafury Lane and SE Lennard Road:** One lane may close intermittently from **8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.** Monday, Nov. 16, through Friday, Nov. 20. Two lanes may close intermittently from **8 p.m. to 6 a.m.** Sunday, Nov. 15, through Friday, Nov. 20, for construction and striping.
- **U.S. 1 between SE Jennings Road and NW Golden Oak Trail:** One lane may close in either direction from **8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.** Monday through Friday and from **8 p.m. to 6 a.m.** Sunday through Friday.
- **SW Port St. Lucie Boulevard between SW Jordin Avenue and SW Alcantarra Boulevard:** One lane may close intermittently in either direction from **8 a.m. to 4 p.m.** Monday, Nov. 16, through Friday, Nov. 20, as the road-widening project continues.

### Extended neighborhood closures off SW Port St. Lucie Boulevard

As part of the widening project, crews plan intermittent extended closures on neighborhood streets for drainage and utility installation. Affected roads may close beginning **7 a.m. Monday, Nov. 16**, and reopen by **5 p.m. Friday, Nov. 20**:

- **SW Jaslo Avenue:** Between SW Jacoby Avenue and SW Paar Drive.
- **SW Koler Avenue:** Between SW Port St. Lucie Boulevard and SW Kober Road.
- **SW McCoy Avenue:** Between SW Port St. Lucie Boulevard and SW Jamros Street.
- **SW McCullough Avenue:** Between SW Jaslo Avenue and SW Port St. Lucie Boulevard.
- **SW McHord Avenue:** Between SW Port St. Lucie Boulevard and SW Kabane Street.
- **SW Paar Drive:** Eastbound between SW Port St. Lucie Boulevard and SW McCandless Street, and westbound between SW Port St. Lucie Boulevard and SW Jaqust Street.

Signed detours will direct drivers to nearby connecting streets. FDOT says neighboring road closures will not occur at the same time and residents and businesses will retain access during construction.

In addition, **SW Port St. Lucie Boulevard itself, between SW Fisherman Avenue and SW Liberty Avenue**, may close intermittently overnight from **9 p.m. to 5 a.m. Monday, Nov. 16, through Friday, Nov. 20**, while utility operations are underway. Northbound motorists will be directed west on Fisherman Avenue, north on Pisano Street and east on Liberty Avenue; southbound motorists will use Liberty Avenue, Pisano Street and Fisherman Avenue.

### North Causeway Bridge, Midway Road and U.S. 1

**The new S.R. A1A/E.C. Summerlin Family Bridge in Fort Pierce remains open to vehicles.** The old drawbridge is being demolished, and related work continues along U.S. 1, Old Dixie Highway, Juanita Avenue and nearby streets. The north-side bicycle lanes and shared-use path remain closed; pedestrians should use the bridge's south-side sidewalk. The new bridge does not connect directly to Old Dixie Highway.

Scheduled restrictions include:

- **U.S. 1 between Juanita Avenue and Naco Road:** One northbound lane may close from **9 a.m. to 5 p.m.** on weekdays through November.
- **Juanita Avenue west of U.S. 1:** The westbound lane may close from **9 a.m. to 5 p.m.** weekdays through November, with flaggers assisting traffic.
- **Harbortown Drive:** One lane in either direction may close from **7 a.m. to 5 p.m.** weekdays through November.
- **U.S. 1 between NE 3rd Street and Juanita Avenue:** One northbound lane may close from **9 a.m. to 5 p.m.** weekdays through November.
- **Old Dixie Highway between Sunny Lane and Juanita Avenue:** One lane in either direction may close from **7 a.m. to 5 p.m.** weekdays, with reconstruction continuing through Dec. 18.
- **S.R. A1A from east of the E.C. Summerlin Family Bridge to Little Jim's Bridge:** One lane in either direction may close from **7 a.m. to 5 p.m.** Monday through Saturday through November.
- **C.R. 712/Midway Road between Florida's Turnpike and Selvitz Road:** One eastbound or westbound lane may close from **9 a.m. to 4 p.m.** weekdays and from **8 p.m. to 6 a.m.** Sunday night through Friday night as widening and resurfacing continue. A westbound traffic shift between NW Corporate Way and Selvitz Road remains in place.

### Port St. Lucie and Fort Pierce maintenance

- **SW Port St. Lucie Boulevard:** Overnight utility work may close a lane between **SW Trenton Lane and SW Cameo Boulevard; SE Midport Road and SE Westmoreland Road; SW Best Street and SE Belvedere Street; SE Whitmore Drive and SE Wald Street; and SW Monterey Lane and SW Bayshore Boulevard**. The listed hours are **9 p.m. to 4 a.m. Monday, Nov. 16, through Friday, Nov. 20**.
- **U.S. 1 in Port St. Lucie:** Northbound daytime lane closures are listed between **SE Huffman Road and Savanna Club Road**, and **SE Jennings Road and SE Village Drive**, for utility work.
- **Midway Road between NW East Torino Parkway and NW Corporate Way:** Intermittent eastbound and westbound daytime lane closures are scheduled for utility installation.
- **Fort Pierce — U.S. 1:** Daytime northbound lane closures are listed near **Ulrich Road, Sunshine Boulevard, Tropical Isles Way, Melton Drive, East Midway Road, Sandhill Boulevard and High Point Boulevard**; additional restrictions are listed near **Pinewood Drive and Georgia Avenue** for signal work.
- **Fort Pierce — S.R. 70/Okeechobee Road:** Intermittent daytime lane closures are scheduled on several segments, including areas near **11 Mile Road, Midway Road, Coolidge Road, Rock Road, Gordy Road and Matthews Road**, for pole replacement.
- **Fort Pierce — S. Kings Highway between Saint Lucie Boulevard and Indrio Road:** Intermittent closures are scheduled from **9 a.m. to 4 p.m.** Monday through Friday for utility work.

## Indian River County

### Four I-95 ramp closures at Oslo Road, Exit 143

Four ramps at the **I-95/Oslo Road interchange** are scheduled for separate closures **Sunday night, Nov. 15, from 9 p.m. to 6 a.m.** for shoulder paving and final asphalt work. FDOT says the closures will be staggered so no two ramps are shut down simultaneously:

- **Northbound I-95 exit to Oslo Road:** Drivers will continue to **S.R. 614/Indrio Road, Exit 138**, then use eastbound Indrio Road and northbound 43rd Avenue SW/Johnston Road to reach Oslo Road.
- **Northbound I-95 entrance from westbound Oslo Road:** Drivers will use **northbound 82nd Avenue, westbound S.R. 60/20th Street**, then enter northbound I-95.
- **Southbound I-95 exit to Oslo Road:** Drivers will continue to **S.R. 60/20th Street, Exit 147**, then use southbound 82nd Avenue to return to Oslo Road.
- **Southbound I-95 entrance from westbound Oslo Road:** Drivers will be directed via **82nd Avenue, 43rd Avenue SW/Johnston Road and Indrio Road** to reach southbound I-95. FDOT lists a separate truck detour.

Additional dates, **Nov. 16–19, Nov. 22–23 and Nov. 30–Dec. 3**, are set aside as contingency nights if needed. FDOT specifies **no lane, shoulder or ramp closures for this project from Wednesday, Nov. 25, through midnight Sunday, Nov. 29**, to reduce Thanksgiving holiday impacts.

Other I-95 and Oslo Road work includes intermittent rolling lane closures on I-95 and interchange ramps from **9 p.m. to 6 a.m.** on selected nights through Dec. 10. Some portions of I-95 near the interchange may have up to two lanes closed overnight for pavement markings, rumble strips, wrong-way detection testing and final work. Near Oslo Road, sections of **58th, 66th, 74th and 82nd avenues** may also have nighttime lane restrictions, with flaggers maintaining traffic.

### Sebastian, 90th Avenue and Sebastian Inlet

- **S.R. 510/90th Avenue between Sebastian Boulevard and 87th Street:** One lane may close intermittently in each direction from **8 p.m. to 6 a.m. Sunday, Nov. 15, through Friday, Nov. 20**, for construction.
- **Advance notice — S.R. 510/90th Avenue:** Extended full overnight closures are planned from **10 p.m. to 6 a.m. Nov. 30–Dec. 3** for drainage work. Detours will use **85th Street, U.S. 1 and Sebastian Boulevard**. Weather contingency dates are Dec. 6–10; homes and businesses will remain accessible.
- **S.R. A1A/Jimmy Buffett Memorial Highway at Sebastian Inlet:** Traffic has been shifted to temporary pavement near the bridge as construction of the replacement bridge continues. The temporary pattern, introduced in October, is expected to remain through **late 2028**.
- **Sebastian Inlet Bridge work zone:** One northbound or southbound lane and/or shoulder may close as needed from **7 a.m. to 5 p.m. Monday through Thursday**, or **7 a.m. to 1 p.m. Friday**, through November. Only one lane will close at a time; flaggers will direct vehicles.
- **Sebastian Inlet State Park:** Portions of both the north and south parking lots remain partially closed for bridge construction. The park remains open, parking is limited, south-jetty access from the south lot is closed, and the boat ramp remains accessible.

### Vero Beach maintenance and utility work

- **U.S. 1 between Vista Royale Boulevard and Spring Lake Drive:** One northbound lane may close from **9 a.m. to 4 p.m. Wednesday, Nov. 18**.
- **U.S. 1 between 24th Street and 21st Street:** One lane may close from **9 a.m. to 4 p.m. Monday, Nov. 16, through Friday, Nov. 20**.
- **S.R. 60/20th Street between 66th Avenue and Indian Creek Boulevard, and between 94th Court and Americana Way:** One eastbound lane may close from **9 a.m. to 4 p.m.** Monday through Friday.
- **U.S. 1 between Bridge Boulevard and Durrance Road, and between 61st Place and 63rd Street:** One northbound lane may close from **9 a.m. to 4 p.m.** Monday through Friday for sign installation.
- **S.R. A1A between Mango Road and Shoe Drive:** One lane may close intermittently from **9 a.m. to 4 p.m. Sunday, Nov. 15, through Thursday, Nov. 19**, for signal upgrades.
- **Westbound S.R. 60 between 97th Road and 98th Avenue:** The left-turn lane may close intermittently from **9 a.m. to 4 p.m.** Monday through Friday.
- **Eastbound S.R. 60 between 33rd Avenue and 26th Avenue:** One lane may close from **9 a.m. to 4 p.m.** Monday through Friday.

These are scheduled construction and maintenance impacts, not real-time incident closures. FDOT says some restrictions may be canceled, postponed or adjusted. Check [FL511](https://www.fl511.com/) for current interstate conditions and [FDOT District 4](https://www.d4fdot.com/) for updated project and lane-closure information before traveling.
